item.tib: dbal chen po rab tu 'khros pa'i rgyud las khro bo stag la me 'bar bdag rdzogs gsang ba mchog gis gzhung srung ba las kyi tan tri
item.coloph: de ltar phyi nang gsang gsum sngags kyi yang snying / stag la bdag rdzogs kyi sgrub pa/ zhes bya ba/ lha klu mi gsum gshen pos/ dbal chen po gtso bo nyid la lung nod nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum gnas su gtan la phab ste/ gshen nam mkha' snang ba mdog can la gtad do/ des zhang zhung gi gshen po dran pa nam mkha' la brgyad do/ dran pa nam mkhas stong dmu tsha gyer med la gtad nas gsungs pa/ nyonacig skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ dmu tsha gyer med sprul pa'i khyod ni 'chi med thugs kyi sras/ g.yung drung bstan pa'i bon la dbang / bdag gis bka' yi gdams pa la/ gsang sngags phyi nang gsang gsum gyis (gyi/)yang gsang man ngag bcud 'dus pa/ zhi khro sgya 'phrul dra ba las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud gsum dang*/ mthar thugs bcud 'dus sgrub pa dang / dbal chen thugs rdzogs sgrub pa dang / rgyud srung bka' gsang lha mo bcas/ rdzogs rim nam mkha' spi gcod bon/ las skal ldan pa khyod la gtod/ khyod kyi (kyis) ma shor dam du zungs/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ kha ba can gyi bod yul du/ bdag gis (gi) bstan pa'i rjes 'dzin pa/ byin gyi rlabs pa'i bu gsum 'byung*/ ming ni shes rab g+ha ru rtsal/ blo ldan snying po bya ba 'byung / bstan pa'i bka' gter bon la dbang / bka' gter ma bu gnyis su spros/ man ngag stong chen thugs la gab/ ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la/ rtsod ldan bskal pa shar ba'i dus/ bdag gis (gi) bstan pa'i rjes 'dzin gsum/ gcig ni sham po'i gangs la dbang / gcig ni zang zang brag la dbang / gcig ni gsang ba'i brag la dbang / khyad par blo ldan snying po la/ zab mo bka' gter gdams pa sprod/ gsang ba'i man ngag u tra sigs/ ces stong dmu tsha gyer med la gdams pa'o/ stong chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi (kyis) phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud do/ gsang ba'i man ngag a ya smar ro/ khro bo'i rgyal po stag la me 'bar gyi sgrub pa rdzogs so/ de ltar khro bo'i rgyal po stag la me 'bar bdag rdzogs kyi sgrubs sgrub) pa/ 'gru btsun shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis/ yang nas yang du bskul nas/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa 'di/ rgyud srungs (srung) dbal mo'i tshogs la bzod pa gsol/ g.yung drung bstan pa dar rgyas brten brtan) 'gyur nas/ 'gro rnams gsang ba sngags kyi don mthong shog
